name: Lee
description: Has <@ba.kw>reduced</> Redeployment Time, but <@ba.kw>DP Cost</> is not refunded upon retreating; While deployed, <@ba.kw>3 DP</> are consumed every 3 seconds (automatically retreats without sufficient DP)

candidates.name: Kindness Begets Prosperity
candidates.description: When Lee is blocking an enemy, the enemy has ASPD -7 and Lee has ASPD +7; If there is only one enemy within the surrounding 8 tiles, this effect is doubled

levels.description: Passive Effect: ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>; Active Effect: Marks the target and makes them easier to be targeted by allies. The mark explodes after <@ba.vup>{paper_duration}</> seconds, dealing <@ba.vup>{default_atk_scale:0%}</> Arts damage to nearby enemies. Every hit on the marked target by allies increases the explosion damage by <@ba.vup>{factor_atk_scale:0%}</> of Lee's ATK (increases up to <@ba.vup>{max_stack_cnt}</> times, and prematurely explodes if the limit is reached or the target is defeated)

levels.description:
<@ba.vup>Expands</> Attack Range, ATK and DEF <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>; Besides the current target, all enemies within range are pushed away <@ba.vup>slightly</> every time Lee attacks. Increases the likelihood of being targeted by enemy attacks and gains a <@ba.vup>{prob:0%}</> chance to dodge Physical or Arts attacks coming from outside his Attack Range
